questions.prompt: The general reported that the enemy had crossed the river during the night.
questions.answer: Dux nūntiāvit hostēs flūmen nocte trānsiisse.

questions.prompt: I know that you did all these things bravely.
questions.answer: Sciō tē haec omnia fortiter ēgisse.

questions.prompt: The messenger announced that the city had been captured after a long siege.
questions.answer: Nūntius urbem longā obsidiōne captam esse renūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: Caesar replied that, if hostages were given, he would make peace.
questions.answer: Caesar respondit, sī obsidēs darentur, sē pācem factūrum esse.

questions.prompt: The envoys promised that they would return before winter.
questions.answer: Lēgātī pollicitī sunt sē ante hiemem reditūrōs esse.

questions.prompt: He said that he would punish the man who had fled.
questions.answer: Dīxit sē pūnītūrum esse eum quī fūgisset.

questions.prompt: They believed that the gods would aid those who fought bravely.
questions.answer: Crēdēbant deōs eīs quī fortiter pugnārent adfutūrōs esse.

questions.prompt: The old man used to say that virtue alone made men happy.
questions.answer: Senex dīcēbat sōlam virtūtem hominēs beātōs facere.

questions.prompt: The historian wrote that the king had reigned for thirty years.
questions.answer: Historicus rēgem trīgintā annōs rēgnāvisse scrīpsit.

questions.prompt: The judge decided that the accused man had committed the crime.
questions.answer: Iūdex reum scelus commīsisse iūdicāvit.

questions.prompt: The philosopher used to teach that the soul was immortal.
questions.answer: Philosophus animum immortālem esse docēbat.

questions.prompt: The farmer complained that the crops had been destroyed by hail.
questions.answer: Agricola frūgēs grandine dēlētās esse questus est.

questions.prompt: The helmsman said that a storm was approaching from the west.
questions.answer: Gubernātor tempestātem ab occidente appropinquāre dīxit.

questions.prompt: He declared that he would never abandon his fatherland.
questions.answer: Adfirmāvit sē numquam patriam dēsertūrum esse.

questions.prompt: The messenger reported that the consul had been killed in battle.
questions.answer: Nūntius cōnsulem in proeliō occīsum esse rettulit.

questions.prompt: I think that you had already read that book.
questions.answer: Putō tē illum librum iam lēgisse.

questions.prompt: The queen promised that she would give gifts to the poet.
questions.answer: Rēgīna sē poētae dōna datūram esse pollicita est.

questions.prompt: The general perceived that his men were fleeing because they feared the enemy.
questions.answer: Dux suōs fugere sēnsit quod hostēs timērent.

questions.prompt: The witness swore that he had seen nothing that night.
questions.answer: Testis sē illā nocte nihil vīdisse iūrāvit.

questions.prompt: The teacher denied that the boys had learned anything.
questions.answer: Magister puerōs quicquam didicisse negāvit.

questions.prompt: Caesar answered that he would spare the city if the citizens surrendered.
questions.answer: Caesar respondit sē urbī parsūrum esse sī cīvēs sē dēdidissent.

questions.prompt: We heard that the enemy had laid waste all the fields.
questions.answer: Audīvimus hostēs omnēs agrōs vāstāvisse.
